name: GP prediction-error model
description: Empirical SGP4 prediction error by orbit regime and prediction age, in RTN. Element sets are propagated to later element sets of the same object (consecutive-set differences, which are not truth) or to independent reference states (GCRF, from analysis/reference-states). Batches accumulate counts, moments and histograms; finalize gives mean, covariance, quantiles, robust sigma and clipped covariance per stratum. With a model on accumulate (reference mode), each error is also tested against its stratum's model covariance (Mahalanobis d^2 against chi-square with 3 degrees of freedom, every sample counted) and finalize gates each stratum CALIBRATED, FAILED or INSUFFICIENT; scale_model fits per-stratum scale factors to reference-state errors.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic SGP4 propagation and statistics over caller-supplied element sets and reference states. No host calls, threads or network access; batches are combined through the prior accumulator.

inputPorts.description: Size-prefixed $OMM records, concatenated, SGP4 mean elements; every element set of each object in the batch (objects are not split across batches). Epochs within one second are one element set republished: the later record is kept.
Independent reference states ($OEM, GCRF, UTC, OBJECT.NORAD_CAT_ID), e.g. analysis/reference-states output. When present, errors are taken against these instead of later element sets.

wildcardJustification.detail: Per regime and prediction age: count, mean and covariance of the six RTN components, quantiles, robust sigma and the clipped covariance, as finalize writes it.

inputPorts.description: A gp-error-model (finalize or scale_model output) whose position covariance each reference-mode sample is tested against: zero-mean Mahalanobis d^2 with the clipped covariance when present.

wildcardJustification.detail: Strata and clipping: regimes [{id, altitudeKm [lo, hi], eccentricity [lo, hi]}], ageBinsDays [[lo, hi]], referenceStepSeconds, clip {k, strata [{regime, age, centre[3], scale[3]}]}; every field optional.

inputPorts.description: Strata and clipping as JSON; every field optional. Defaults: ten regimes by mean altitude and eccentricity, age bins 0-0.5, 0.5-1, 1-2, 2-3, 3-5, 5-7 days, reference step 300 s, no clipping.
